description: I2.2 Hand-built enforcement hooks - three enforcement rules for code quality and security

PreToolUse.name: block-dangerous-shell-commands
PreToolUse.description: Block shell commands that modify or delete critical files

args: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git push.*--force|:(){:|:& };:'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected' && exit 2; fi

PreToolUse.name: prevent-secrets-commit
PreToolUse.description: Prevent committing files with potential secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens)

args: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit'; then FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null || echo ''); for f in $FILES; do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qiE '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)[\s:=\"]+[\w\-_]{16,}' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'BLOCKED: Potential secret detected in $f' && exit 2; fi; done; fi

PostToolUse.name: auto-lint-on-write
PostToolUse.description: Run linter on Python files after writing

Stop.name: log-session-complete
Stop.description: Log session completion for audit trail
